name: Shelf Count Plan
title: ABC-123: show how many books are on each shelf
meta: Example plan: invented ticket, shows the shape of a plan file
Nothing is committed until you say so
context: The shelves page lists books but never says how many are on each shelf. This change adds a count per shelf, shown next to the shelf name. The count is computed from the existing shelf data, so nothing in the database changes. The controller only passes the numbers on to the page; the service decides what is counted and how a missing user is treated; the repository runs the query.
